content.query:
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns
WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CUSTOMERACCOUNTPARTICIPATION'

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation

SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE CustomerAccountId = '1664351'
AND CustomerId = 'R00191477'
SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
WHERE CustomerAccountId = '2389282'


SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
WHERE CustomerAccountId = '62621362b90ae976c9bbc33453c00c59'

SELECT COUNT(1) DUP_CNT, SourceSystemCode FROM (
SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, SerialNumber, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, count(1) CNT
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipation 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, SerialNumber, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
HAVING count(1) > 1 ) A
GROUP BY SourceSystemCode
